posts.preview: Accounts with a verified badge have been authenticated and can be Meta Verified subscribers or notable persons or brands.

Barloworld Equipment Namibia has, over the years, been regarded as one of the best employers in Namibia. However, recent developments involving the targeting and apparent replacement of Black senior managers raise serious concerns

It is disappointing that a company of this magnitude appears unable to trust a qualified Namibian to lead as Country Manager. There is nothing unique about this position that a capable Namibian cannot do. A Namibian previously held this position, so why not now?
As a country, we must strictly regulate the duration of work permits for foreign nationals occupying senior management positions, particularly where qualified Namibians are available
